user.title: Neo Smart Controller
user.description: Enter the controller's address. It is shown under Your Controllers in the Neo app.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Neo Smart Controller.
data_description.protocol: HTTP is recommended because the controller reports errors over HTTP. TCP can't tell you if a command was wrong.

data_description.port: 8838 for HTTP, 8839 for TCP, unless you have changed it.
data_description.hub_id: The 24-character controller ID, shown under Your Controller in the Neo app. Required for HTTP, not used for TCP.

reauth_confirm.title: Controller ID not recognised
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} did not recognise the controller ID. Enter the 24-character ID shown under Your Controller in the Neo app.

error.invalid_hub_id: The controller ID is 24 letters and digits.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller on that host and port.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.

data_description.name: What the blind is called in Home Assistant.
data_description.blind_code: ID1.ID2-channel, for example 021.230-04. Shown on the blind's advanced page in the Neo app. Channel 01 to 14 is one blind, 15 is the whole room.
data_description.motor_code: Pick the motor brand, or type any two-character code. Leave empty if your blind has no motor code.
data_description.rail: Which rail this entry controls. Use 2 or 3 only for top-down/bottom-up blinds.
data_description.tdbu_extended: Use the u4/d4/x2 command set. Only for top-down/bottom-up blinds with motor code mb, ra, ap or db.
data_description.tilt: Adds tilt open and close buttons that send micro-steps. Only works on rails that have micro-step commands.
data_description.percent_support: How Home Assistant handles positions for this blind.
data_description.close_time: Seconds from fully open to fully closed.
data_description.open_time: Seconds from fully closed to fully open. Leave empty to use the close time.
data_description.startup_sync: Send open or close when Home Assistant starts, so the position is known. Not sent when the integration reloads.
data_description.start_position: Position to assume (0 to 100) before any position has been saved.
data_description.parent_group: Optional. The code for the blind's room, ending in -15, for example 021.230-15. Blinds that share a room code get a room cover and send room commands together.

measure.title: Measure open and close times
measure.description: This times how long {name} takes to close and to open. Press Submit to open the blind fully.

measure_opened.title: Opening
measure_opened.description: Wait until the blind is fully open and has stopped. Then press Submit: the blind starts closing and the timer starts.

measure_closing.title: Closing
measure_closing.description: Press Submit as soon as the blind stops at the bottom. The blind then starts opening and a new timer starts.

measure_opening.title: Opening
measure_opening.description: Press Submit as soon as the blind stops at the top.

error.invalid_blind_code: Enter a blind code like 021.230-04. ID1 and ID2 are 000 to 255, the channel is 00 to 15.
error.invalid_motor_code: A motor code is two letters or digits.
error.extended_not_supported: The extended commands only work with motor codes mb, ra, ap and db.
error.position_not_supported: "Blind moves to the position" needs the top rail, no extended commands, and a motor code that accepts positions (no, db, ra, rb, ap, bl, mb, jo) or no motor code.
error.invalid_time: Enter a time in seconds greater than 0.
error.invalid_room_code: A room code looks like 021.230-15 and must end in -15.
error.already_configured: This blind code, motor code and rail is already set up on this controller.
error.command_failed: The command could not be sent. Check the controller and try again.

abort.measured: Saved. Close time {close_time} s, open time {open_time} s.

init.title: Room names
init.description: Name each room code shared by two or more blinds: {rooms}. Unnamed rooms are called Room followed by the room code.

abort.no_rooms: No room code is shared by two or more blinds yet. Set the same room code on at least two blinds first.

deprecated_yaml.title: Neo Smart Blinds YAML has been imported
deprecated_yaml.description: Your `cover:` entries with `platform: {domain}` have been imported into the UI. Remove them from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

yaml_import_failed.title: Neo Smart Blinds could not import {name}
yaml_import_failed.description: The YAML blind {name} was not imported: {reason}. Add it from the UI instead (Settings > Devices & services > Neo Smart Blinds > Add blind), then remove it from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends any two-character action to the selected blinds or rooms. Warning: programming actions can change or wipe a motor's settings. Only use actions you understand.

command.name: Command
command.description: Two-character action, for example gp or i1.
